Dialog.message_box.title: Message Dialog
Dialog.message_box.comment: Open a message dialog, configure the message content and title

box_title.title: Dialog Title
box_title.tip: Custom title displayed at the top of the dialog. Max 50 characters. If left empty, the default title 'Message Dialog' is used

message_content.title: Message Content
message_content.tip: Custom content displayed in the dialog. Max 120 characters

button_type.title: Display Buttons
button_type.tip: Buttons shown to the user. Only switching is allowed; empty selection is not permitted

wait_time.title: Inactivity Timeout (seconds)
wait_time.tip: Set timeout duration. If no mouse movement is detected within this time, the default button is selected. Default is 60 seconds

Dialog.input_box.title: Input Dialog
Dialog.input_box.comment: Open an input dialog requiring the user to enter and submit information. Returns the content entered by the user

box_title.title: Dialog Title
box_title.tip: Max 50 characters. If left empty, the default title 'Input Dialog' is used

default_input_text.title: Default Input Value
default_input_text.tip: If filled, the dialog displays this as default placeholder text. Max 120 characters

default_input_pwd.title: Default Input Value
default_input_pwd.tip: If filled, the dialog displays this as the default password. Password length must be between 4 and 16 characters

Dialog.select_box.title: Selection Dialog
Dialog.select_box.comment: Open a selection dialog. Saves one or more options selected by the user from the list

Dialog.select_time_box.title: Date/Time Picker
Dialog.select_time_box.comment: Open a date/time picker. Saves the date or time selected by the user

Dialog.select_file_box.title: File Selection Dialog
Dialog.select_file_box.comment: Open the system file selection dialog. Saves the file/folder path selected by the user

default_path.title: Default Folder
default_path.tip: When configured, the file selection dialog opens at this folder path by default

select_file.title: Save File Selection Result To
select_file.tip: Saves the user's file selection result. Returns empty if the user clicks Cancel

Dialog.custom_box.title: Custom Dialog
Dialog.custom_box.comment: Open a custom dialog. Users can design the dialog interface and input controls. Saves user input and button click results

design_interface.title: Design Dialog Interface
design_interface.tip: Click the button to open the dialog designer

dialog_result.title: Custom Dialog Result
dialog_result.tip: Stores the output of all form controls and the button click result
